section: Hero: a sand panel with the title, standfirst, host and episode beside a large photograph
fields: Title (the page title at the top of the editor)
Insight box, below the title: Title highlight
notes: Choose the Podcast format first, so the Podcast details box appears under the editor.
Title highlight is the part of the title shown in coral. Type it exactly as it appears in the title.
The byline says "Hosted by" with the chosen team member's photograph. If no host is chosen, the WordPress author is shown instead.
The Episode is shown beside the date as "Episode 7". Type just the number, or something like Ep7 (the "Ep" is tidied away).

section: Podcast details strip: episode, sponsor and the Listen button
fields: Podcast details box: Sponsor / partner logo
notes: The strip shows the episode, the sponsor logo under "Sponsored by" and a Listen button that opens the Listen link in a new tab.
The Listen link can go to Spotify, Apple Podcasts or YouTube. Leave the sponsor logo empty to hide the Sponsored by part.
The sponsor logo is also shown on the home page hero card.
Use Heading 2 for each section, for example In this episode. They build the On this page list.

section: Sidebar: On this page and the timeline form
notes: There is nothing to fill in. The form is the same on every insight.

section: Related insights and the closing call to action
notes: Three other insights that share a Topic are shown automatically.
The dark "Interested in working with us?" band is a shared pattern.
